title: 04/02/21 - Software Updates | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: 04/02/21 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078823 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. We updated the checkboxes in the "Page Options" tab when editing a page using the Web Page Builder in the Admin. We added the Schema Markup for the Post Comments Add-On on the frontend of sites. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Website Blog Article Bootstrap Theme - Detail Page - Schema Markup - Community Article We updated the layout of the results when viewing the Bookmark My Favorites Add-On in the Member Dashboard area. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings Bootstrap Theme - Account - Favorites Controller We updated the Form Manager to display an error message in a modal when trying to customize a Default Form that is already customized. We created a unique Text Label for the "Month" text on the Simple Events Calendar Add-On. Text Label Involved: calendar_month We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the Member Photo Upload module after submitting the Basic Information for a multi-image post in the Member Dashboard area in some cases. We created a new Design Setting called "Link & Font Size" to set the font-size of the links shown in the site's Header. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> General tab >> Header Colors. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Custom Appearance Settings We implemented a security update to the Media Manager page in the Admin to protect against unauthorized access to the tool. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from properly displaying member names in some languages in the Recent Members widget in some cases. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Display - Recent Members We fixed an issue which was preventing the correct amount from displaying on invoices when the "1.234,56" Currency Number Format was selected in some cases. We added the ability to upload ".ttf" files through the Media Manager page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying bookmarked Video Posts in the Member Dashboard area in some cases. Bootstrap Theme - Account - Favorites Controller We updated the layout of the Yes/No fields powered by the Form Manager to use an On/Off switch design. We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from disabling the auto-pluralization of the "Review" text label on Member Profile Pages. We fixed an issue which was causing the system to not respect the selected date format on the Reviews Profile and Search Results pages in some cases. Post Type Involved: Review We updated the Forms Inbox page in the Admin to also list submissions of the Newsletter Form moving forward. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Module - Newsletter Actions We added the ability to set a custom message after selecting the "Display Success Pop-up Message" or "Display Success Alert Message" options on the "What Happens After Form Submitted" form settings when editing form settings in the Admin. Using the "Close My Account" action in the Member Dashboard area is now being logged in the Activity Tracker. The Website Currency Number Format setting found in the General Settings >> Localization tab will now also impact other numbers shown on the frontend of sites. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Sidebar Bootstrap Theme - Member Results - Sorting Options We updated the Form Inbox page in order to add a link to the Member who submitted an inquiry if applicable. We fixed an issue which was causing the signup pages to not work properly when using double quotes to the "Duplicate Email Error" field validation message. We fixed an issue which was causing the Simple Events Calendar Add-On to show all event posts even when the members who made the posts no longer have permission to make event posts. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Function - Events Calendar JSON Array We added the ability to choose a dates prior to the currently-selected Start Date in date picker fields when creating posts in the Member Dashboard. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Footer - Scripts We fixed an issue which was causing the system to redirect to an incorrect URL when editing Multi-Image post types in the Member Dashboard in some cases. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
